summary: Retest of the iteration 170 Control Room Phase 3 fixes. Backend, run serially (-n 0): the new test_controlroom_phase3_retest171.py passes 9 of 10. test_controlroom_phase3_itv.py and the edge suite pass 24 of 25; the edge suite is now 4 of 4, including test_partito_after_central_confirm_on_segnalato. Phase 1 and 2 regression passes 39 of 39. Verified fixes: (1) PARTITO after a radio confirm on a SEGNALATO intervention now auto-steps preso_in_carico→squadra_inviata, with history and t_presa/t_invio set; RISOLTO from SEGNALATO walks all 4 steps; ARRIVATO from IN_ATTESA works. (2) Backward PARTITO/ARRIVATO on SUL_POSTO returns 409 with no side effects: the assignment stays non_confermata, the version does not change and no diary row is added. A second RISOLTO returns 409. (3) Annulling sets the assignments to 'completata' and frees the resource; after reopen senza_squadra=true and the resource can be reassigned. (4) A coordinatore scoped to S1 gets 403 on PUT with km in S2 or sector_id=S2, while an edit inside S1 returns 200. (5) GET/POST health on an unknown iid returns 404. (6) A message to coordinatori creates a centrale notification. One regression found: after fix (3), a mobile action on a closed intervention returns 403 'Questo intervento non ti è assegnato' instead of 409 'già chiuso'. UI mobile 390 (/cr/op/{token}): buttons match the state on all five setup interventions. SEGNALATO+confermata shows conferma/partito/arrivato. SUL_POSTO shows conferma (assignment not yet confirmed) and risolto only. PRESO_IN_CARICO shows partito/arrivato. CHIUSO shows no actions. Clicking PARTITO on SEGNALATO gives the toast and moves the state to SQUADRA INVIATA with arrivato/risolto shown; RISOLTO leaves only AGGIORNA. No horizontal overflow. UI desktop 1920: the bell dropdown closes on outside click, Escape and a second toggle; side tabs are 28px tall; the Interventi list defaults to the table. At 390 it defaults to cards, the bell list fits in the viewport and an outside tap closes it. No JS page errors.

minor.issue: Regression caused by the 'completata on close' fix. On a chiuso/annullato intervention, the active-assignment lookup (stato in ACTIVE_ASG) now finds nothing, so the endpoint returns 403 'Questo intervento non ti è assegnato' before reaching the CLOSED check (409 'Intervento già chiuso o annullato'). The operator gets a misleading message. Fix in m_action: move the `if it['stato'] in CLOSED: 409` check BEFORE the assignment check, or look up the assignment including 'completata' for that check. Old test_controlroom_phase3_itv.py::TestMobile::test_actions fails on this (expects 409).

Still not fully atomic when steps are valid: set_asg (confirm) runs before the transitions loop. If a transition then fails (e.g. a 409 version race with the centrale), the assignment stays confirmed with a diary row. Low impact.

action_items: In m_action (controlroom_itv.py ~l.726-731), check it['stato'] in CLOSED → 409 before the 'non ti è assegnato' 403, so actions on closed interventions keep returning 409.
critical_code_review_comments: controlroom_itv.py is 795 lines (>700): consider splitting the mobile endpoints (m_*) into their own module.

m_action: the assignment confirm runs before the multi-step transitions, so a partial failure leaves the assignment confirmed but the state unchanged. Consider validating the version/steps first or confirming after the transitions.

The CR suites share one event and assume sequential state. Under the default pytest.ini (-n 2 --dist loadscope) the phase3_itv/edge modules each create their own W fixture in the same event, so overlap counts and INT code sequences race (5 spurious failures in a parallel run). Run them with -n 0.

success_rate.backend: 97% (72/74 serial runs; 1 real regression counted in 2 tests)
